name: Gentiana macrophylla (qinjiao) compound tablet
short: Sparse data: one 1989 lupus report (most also took prednisone) found no apparent side effects of a tablet of unstated make-up; a review says proper toxicity evaluation is indispensable.
text: Human safety data come from a single 1989 report in systemic lupus erythematosus, available as an English abstract: 62 patients took a Gentiana macrophylla complex tablet together with prednisone, 19 took prednisone alone, and 8 took the tablet alone, and the authors reported no apparent side effects of the tablet. The abstract does not give the tablet's composition, does not say how side effects were looked for, and most patients who took the tablet also took prednisone. A 2018 review of Qinjiao, the dried roots of Gentiana macrophylla and related Gentiana species, states that proper toxic evaluation is indispensable to guarantee its safety, efficacy and eligibility for medical use; the abstract reports no toxicity findings. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
